in_marathi.name: Sargun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sargun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sargun is derived from the Sanskrit word Sar, which means 'that which is in motion' and Gun, which means 'progress'. This name signifies continuous progress and motion, both in physical and spiritual aspects of life.
